findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The nozzles of the soda machines within the facility were observed with soil accumulations. The PIC was made aware. The PIC immediately got a sanitizer bucket with water and brush to clean and sanitize the nozzles. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the soda nozzles are monitored, cleaned and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The fan unit in the walk-in cooler was observed with soil and dust accumulation. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspector that the fan will be cleaned. Ensure that the soil and dust are cleaned to prevent possible contamination of food items.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed. 
1. An accumulation of grease was observed under the fryers.
2. There were several tiles observed missing under the fryers. The area had been filled with bare concrete that is continuously absorbing the grease and accumulating soil and dust including food debris.
3. An accumulation of ice was observed int he walk-in freezer.
 Discussed with the PIC. The PIC assured inspector that the accumulations will be cleaned and the relevant repairs will be done.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff failure to use a barrier to shut the faucet after washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and the behavior was corrected. Ensure staff are aware to use a barrier to shut the faucet at the hand sink after handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

Ensure that this surface is clean and sanitized to removed the current accumulated soil and food debris and then is monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed several wet mop heads and rags being stored on the floor of the mop sink. Discussed with PIC and PIC asked a staff member to get the wet mop heads and rags cleaned and stored properly. Ensure that wet mop heads and rags are cleaned and store appropriately to avoid pathogen growth.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.15 Cleaning Maintenance Tools, Preventing Contamination. FOOD preparation sinks, HANDWASHING SINKS, and WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may not be used for the cleaning of maintenance tools, the preparation or holding of maintenance materials, or the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The magnetic knife strip above the triple sink is observed to have rusted and is in direct contact with the food contact surface of the knife on it. This knife was pulled from service and placed into the wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. Ensure this magnetic knife strip is removed and replaced if desired to have this piece of equipment in use. If this item does not want to be used in the facility, then the magnetic knife strip can simply be removed and then any holes in the wall can be patched. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: In the walk-in freezer there are multiple boxes observed stored directly on the floor. When brought to the PIC’s attention, employees were immediately instructed to relocate the boxes off the floor. Ensure that food storage takes place in these locations where the boxes are stored at least 6 inches off the floor. 
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The bottom shelf of the fry freezer and the external surface/gaskets of the fry freezer are observed with an accumulation of food debris. The top of the fry warmer is also observed with an accumulation of food debris/grease. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation of food debris/grease and then are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following locations are observed to be soiled and are in need of attention to detail when cleaning:
-The sandwich prep cooler under the lid near the back wall.
-The ice cream machine has a visible spill on the containers inside the cooler part of the machine.
Ensure these locations receive proper attention to detail when cleaning and are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. This is a repeated violation form the 4/24/2023 inspection and the facility will receive a Notice to Correct to document the violation. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The triple sink is observed to have a substantial water leak taking place where the spray nozzle is attached. This item needs to be repaired in a manner that prevents it from leaking. 
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The fry freezer gasket is observed to be in a state of disrepair where the gasket has rolled over and exposed a gap where food accumulation is occurring. Ensure this area is cleaned of the food accumulation and that the gasket is repaired to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The wall and areas surrounding the hand sink near the ice cream is observed to have an accumulation of food debris/soils. Ensure the current accumulation is cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation and then ensure the surfaces are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
